answer: Funding-lineage panel exclusion stops a farm from grading its own work. The ledger traces each seat's funding delta, its first inbound coins, back to their source, and seats drawing over 20% from a common wallet may not share a jury panel or grade each other. Such seats stand on one mesa, a single vantage point. One whale seeding a garden of 40 personas wins one slot on a 7-seat panel, while capturing the 4-grade quorum needs 4 separately earned or bought balances. Routing coins through fresh wallets fails, since lineage follows value, not addresses.
